image_description: A low-angle shot of a large, ornate pipe organ installed in a wooden gallery or balcony. The instrument features multiple tiers of vertical silver/metallic pipes of varying heights, arranged symmetrically around a central protruding section. The casing is made of polished dark wood with decorative moldings and columns. The lighting is warm, highlighting the metallic sheen of the pipes and the wood grain.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Multiple rows of vertical metal or wooden pipes of varying heights arranged symmetrically.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The image clearly displays multiple distinct groups of vertical metallic pipes. They are arranged symmetrically around the central axis of the organ case, with visible variation in height within each group.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Pipe heights range from very short compact pipes to dramatically towering pipes creating a dramatic stepped silhouette.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: There is a clear visual gradient in pipe height. The outer pipes in the upper tiers are significantly taller than the inner ones, and the lower central pipes are shorter than the upper main display, creating the characteristic stepped silhouette.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The image is cropped at the bottom of the visible pipe work/gallery railing. The console (keyboards and pedalboard) is located below this frame and is not visible.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the specific classification of the instrument and distinguish it from other large architectural structures or generic 'organ' classes.
To verify the 3D spatial relationship between the pipes and the wooden case, ensuring pipes do not melt into the background or float unnaturally.
To check for boundary bleeding between adjacent pipes and ensure each pipe is a distinct, continuous cylindrical entity without fusion artifacts.
To assess general texture consistency, lighting coherence, and detect any subtle AI-generation noise or blur.

focus_areas: Boundary sharpness between metallic pipes and wooden case
Consistency of metallic reflections across pipes
Structural integrity of the wooden gallery/casing
